faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our services, timelines, technology stack, and development process.
faq.support_description: Our team is available to answer any questions and craft a tailored proposal for your project.

q1.question: How much does a website cost?
q1.answer: Pricing depends on your project's complexity, features, and goals. We build everything from high-converting landing pages to full web platforms and bespoke systems. We provide clear, tailored proposals designed to maximize your return on investment.

q2.question: How long does it take to create a website?
q2.answer: Delivery times depend on the scope. Landing pages and institutional sites are usually delivered within 1 to 3 weeks. Larger solutions, such as custom e-commerce or scalable web applications, take 4 to 12 weeks with staged agile deliveries.

q3.question: What results should I expect?
q3.answer: You get a fast, modern, conversion-optimized platform that instantly establishes authority. In practice, this means higher visitor engagement, more qualified leads, enhanced brand reputation, and increased sales opportunities.

q4.question: Do you offer support after the website launch?
q4.answer: Yes! We provide post-launch warranties, ongoing maintenance plans, and continuous support covering security updates, automated backups, performance tuning, and new feature rollouts.

q5.question: Will the website work seamlessly on mobile and tablets?
q5.answer: Absolutely. Every project is developed with a mobile-first philosophy, ensuring your site loads quickly and provides an intuitive experience across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and wide monitors.

q6.question: Is the website optimized for Google (SEO)?
q6.answer: Yes. We implement technical SEO best practices from the start: semantic markup, social share meta tags, rapid load times, Schema.org structured data, and automated sitemaps for optimal search engine indexing.

q7.question: Will I be able to update text and images myself?
q7.answer: Yes! We can integrate an intuitive management dashboard (CMS) allowing your team to update copy, images, products, or blog articles independently without requiring technical skills or coding.

q8.question: Do you handle domain registration and web hosting?
q8.answer: Yes. We assist you through domain registration or migration, high-availability cloud infrastructure setup, SSL security certificates, and professional business emails.

q9.question: How does the development workflow operate?
q9.answer: Our process is transparent and structured: we begin with discovery and requirements scoping, design modern prototypes in Figma for your review, build the production code, execute rigorous tests, and finalize with deployment.

q10.question: Can you integrate payments and WhatsApp automation?
q10.answer: Yes. We build complete integrations with WhatsApp click-to-chat, payment gateways (such as Stripe), CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and third-party APIs.
